_description: Battle simulator v1 (tools/nn/sim, docs/en/training/simulator.md): the numbers that are neither in a unit passport (config/nn/units.json) nor in the game's rules (config/nn/game_rules.json). Each is measured in the game or calibrated to a measurement (docs/en/training/measurements.md); `why` says which. Written by hand; python -m tools.nn.sim.check compares the simulator with the game.

step_s.why: morale rises 2 points a second before contact in every recording (+0.057 MoralePercent/s at leadership 35 ... +0.029 at 70) = one point (minimium_increment_update_per_tick) per 0.5 s tick

battle_limit_s.why: network plan: 60 minutes, the attacker loses on time

map_half_m.why: measured: routing units leave the map at |x| or |z| = 1020 m (Crossroads flat, 28 runs)

formation.why: arena spearmen: 120 men, width 30 m, rank_depth 6 -> 20 files 1.5 m apart; ranks the same. Centre distance at first contact in the pairs (7.5-12.8 m) matches the depths this gives

contact.why: reach: pairs touch when the formations' edges meet (centre distance 10.6-12.8 m for spearmen against slaves, depths 9 and 13.5 m). lord_max_attackers: melee.md (up to ~8 reach a lord). Front = within 60 deg of the facing (shield_defence_angle_melee 60), rear = beyond 120 deg. melee_turn_deg_s: a formation in melee turns no faster (a lord at once): measured in the 28 whole battles, infantry in melee standing turns 1 deg/s (median, mean 2.3; 20.8k seconds), a free unit struck in the flank turns 8 deg in the next 5 s (median, 653 contacts). step_m: a unit whose point is nearer does not turn to walk there (formations step back or aside facing the enemy); without it, units replayed to their recorded points stood with their backs to the enemy at contact in the pairs

melee.why: calibrated on the four melee pairs (tools/nn/sim/check.py). The database rule hit = 35 + attack - defence does not fit: the losses of all four pairs and both lords need about the same 30-38 % whatever attack - defence is (from -35 to +31); hit_slope scales attack - defence (1 = the database rule). fighting_files: men striking = this share of the files in contact (0.75 x 20 = 15 of a 30 m front). impact: extra damage of a charging unit in the first 13 s (charge_decay_duration), times the charge factor; fitted to the HP lost in the first 15 s of the pairs, then lowered from 2.5 to 1.5 on the 28 whole battles (01.10.2026): there a unit charged while standing lost 0.82 of what its charger lost in the first 15 s (102 contacts), the simulator at 2.5 gave 2.7; at 1.5 the pairs stay 51 of 54 within 20 %. flank_slope / rear_slope: defence lost to a flank / rear attack counts at this weight of the rule (1 = the database rule; a lone man always 1): fitted so that infantry fought on the flank loses 1.74x (1.56-1.89 over runs) and on the rear 1.31x (1.19-1.42) what it loses from the front in the whole battles (5.5k / 2.1k seconds; sector by the angle of the enemy's centre, as the simulator counts it); the simulator gives 1.55 / 1.50. braced_speed: a unit with charge_reflection slower than this (m/s) at contact is braced and meets a frontal infantry charge as a charge (measured: braced spearmen charged head-on lose 0.80 of what the charger loses, 87 contacts; the database's charge_reflect_min_charge_factor_threshold 0.7 is not applied, chargers here meet their target at 0.55-0.9 of their run)

kills.why: men lost per HP lost: blows that do not kill wound; men share = max(1 - g (1 - hp share), hp share), g = (hits to kill)^-exponent; fitted to men against health in the pairs (at half health: slaves 0.6 of men, spearmen 0.7-0.78; lords kill whole men: 1)

missile.why: measured (measurements.md, shooting at a unit that stands): reload in practice 11.0 s arrows (passport 10) and 11.5 s sling (passport 9); hit rate at the edge of range 0.42 and 0.47; first shot 3.3 and 4.3 s after halting. Other projectiles: the mean, reload x1.2 of the passport. distance_factor: HP per arrow against the distance, relative to 105-130 m, from the range test (28.09.2026, standing spearmen: c = 13.4 at 70 m, 11.6 at 90 m, 9.5-10.4 at 105-120 m), held below 70 m; the arena's 34 m (~25 HP) and 52 m (~18 HP) are left out: they exceed or reach the arrow's whole damage (19), so melee losses are mixed in. single_entity_factor: HP a lord loses per projectile aimed at him while he is out of melee for the whole flight (the shot's second and the 2 s after), against the unit rule with his armour, shield (by the shooter's side), resistance and distance factor: 0.43 over ~33k shots of the 18 mirror and 10 Empire-Skaven battles (General by arrows ~0.5, by sling ~0.37, Warlord by arrows ~0.32; per battle median 0.43). An earlier count gave 0.9: its 2-second loss windows overlapped and counted each loss twice. friendly_fire: of the hits aimed at a unit in melee, the share that lands on the shooter's own units in contact with it. Measured in the recordings: in the seconds a missile unit shoots an enemy that fights its own units (and nobody shoots those units), their HP lost beyond the melee rule (and beyond the 1.15x / 1.5x they lose when their own side does not shoot), against those shots' hits by the unit rule: arrows 0.26 (18 mirror battles, 1.5k seconds), sling 0.56 (10 Empire-Skaven battles, 1.3k seconds); other projectiles: the mean. spill: of the hits aimed at a unit, the share that lands on each other unit of the target's side out of melee, by the distance between their centres: in the recordings a unit nobody shoots at, out of melee, with an enemy-shot neighbour within 30 m loses 0.115 of the hits that neighbour takes by the unit rule (2.1k seconds), 0.034 at 30-60 m (6.3k), 0.015 at 60-90 m (7.2k), 0.005 beyond (units with no shot neighbour lose 0.7 HP/s); it is why an infantry unit in a whole battle loses ~1.3x per shot aimed at it what the lone target of the shooting arena does. Without it a unit in melee loses 3.2x the melee rule (Skaven infantry) and 2.2x (Empire infantry, mirror) while its own missile units shoot at the enemy it fights, 1.5x and 1.15x otherwise

morale.why: faction_bonus: before contact Skaven units stand 6 points higher than the Empire's in the same place (slaves, clanrats, slingers; pairs, shooting, whole battles). recent_s / recent_of_current: the window of 'recent casualties' (the database gives the penalties, not the window) and whether its share is of the health left; calibrated on the waver and rout times of the pairs and the shooting. combat_ratio: melee HP dealt / taken for winning slightly, winning, significantly (the database gives only the points). rally_mp: a routing unit rallies at MoralePercent ~0.23 (morale.md, median 0.22 at 365 rallies). rally_free_m: no standing enemy that near (at 365 rallies of the mirror and Empire-Skaven battles the nearest standing enemy was 91 m or more in 90 %). rally_rate: points a second a routing unit regains while free, calibrated to the rallies of the whole battles (median 44 s). rout_floor_mp: where morale stands at most when the rout begins (recorded MoralePercent at the rout: median -0.03, 10 % below -0.17). rout_speed: a routing unit runs at this share of its run speed (median of the recorded routing speed: Empire units 0.80-0.86, Skaven 0.85-0.96). attacked_flank / attacked_rear: points while an enemy strikes from the flank / rear, instead of the database's was_attacked_in_flank -6 / _rear -14: regressing morale points - leadership of infantry in melee in the 28 whole battles (30k seconds; on health lost, flank, rear, contacts, the lf/rf/bf flags, under fire) gives -1.0 / -1.8, while the same regression on the simulator with the database's points gives -1 / -14.5. The same regression gives -3.9 / -8.1 for one / several of lf, rf, bf: the database's ume_concerned_flanks_exposed_single / _multiple -3 / -6, used as they are

fatigue.why: the database gives points per activity but not the time; regressing the recorded fatigue states (18 mirror battles, 1315 transitions) gives 5.0x a second for melee, 4.8x for shooting, 6.2x for running

threat.why: lf / rf / bf: a non-routing enemy within this distance in the left, right or rear sector; not calibrated
